public_windows_runtime.scope: Eleven corpora using the verified Windows x64 portable package and adjacent bundled runtime. Recorded commands exclude subprocesses internal to the Python/PowerShell validators. The workbook helper binds its PDFium setting to the verified package directory. The units corpus also uses the separately pinned published 0.69 package for old-reader controls; current and legacy CLI counts are distinct. Development, draft and public checks are separate repetitions, not additive coverage.

local_retention.scope: Byte-for-byte retained copies of the eight release assets; no additional runtime coverage.

pdf_visual_review.scope: Visual inspection of seven specified pages rendered from four PDFs produced by the exact downloaded 0.72.0 draft package. These seven render commands are outside the eleven-corpus command totals. No native desktop interaction.
observations: Complete and partial summaries are readable, with separate quantity, currency and missing-value/error coverage.
The technical appendix wraps its provenance and settings without clipping or collision with the page footer.
Latin accents and the displayed CJK text render legibly; supported legend samples are visible and unknown appearances remain explicitly marked.
Numeric fields and formula results retain their units and area/volume superscripts. All seven inspected pages have readable text and clear separation from their footers.

development.scope: Frozen development source. Separate from downloaded-package qualification; counts are not additive.

native_plan_workflows.scope: Combined 0.72 interactive Windows workflows and native spreadsheet acceptance remain pending because the local application-control connection was unavailable. Offscreen reader scenes, Ubuntu container smoke tests and rendered report pages do not establish this acceptance.

private_project_plan_qualification.reason: Deferred at the owner request; synthetic evidence does not establish real-project survey accuracy.

limitations: Windows packages unsigned; ARM64 built without physical-hardware execution.
Development, draft and public corpus passes are repeated checks, not additive coverage.
Recorded commands exclude subprocesses internal to the two validation helpers.
Visual PDF review covers only the specified rendered pages, not native desktop interaction.
No universal PDF/A/PDF/UA, complete OOXML schema, physical printing, human accessibility or survey-accuracy claim.

Boundary fill is qualified on frozen synthetic raster geometry only. Resolution and threshold are explicit; open, ambiguous or excessive contours are refused. No physical measurement accuracy or native interaction is claimed.
Visual search accuracy is measured on controlled same-scale synthetic fixtures only; arbitrary symbol classes, angles and scale invariance are not qualified.
The 2-degree case is characterization only and is reported separately from required accuracy gates.

symbol_visual_review.scope: Visual inspection of three specified package-generated synthetic diagnostic images; not all images, not native desktop interaction or real drawing qualification.
observations: The displayed templates retain the asymmetric inner shape and distinguish the separately characterized distorted raster.
Candidate boxes in the contact sheet align with the visible expected same-scale symbols; partial edge distractors remain excluded.
The cropped and rotated page-two comparison aligns all six displayed candidates with the expected quarter-turns; the mirrored symbol and empty square remain unselected.
The saved-page panels show count markers at explicitly selected centers, without marking the displayed unselected distractors.

boundary_visual_review.scope: Visual inspection of five specified package-generated synthetic images: analytic geometry comparisons, a saved raw PDF render and the actual CLI preview. Not all 22 images, not native desktop interaction or physical measurement accuracy.
observations: The two-hole comparison aligns the displayed outer contour and both hole contours with the independently drawn analytic boundaries.
The saved raw PDF and CLI preview retain both deductions and show the same readable 2.9952 m2 area below the outer contour.
The 90-degree cropped-page comparison keeps the outer boundary and both holes aligned in the rotated displayed coordinates.
The manual doorway closure is explicit in orange and completes the displayed contour across the opening without a visible leak or added hole.

linux.scope: Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 clean containers; installed package under a normal user; Xvfb/software rendering; same-version remove and reinstall, not physical GPU qualification.

result.scope: Machine validation of the specified profiles and first-page appearance; human PDF/UA semantics remain unqualified.
